pipeline.title: How IP-SAKTI Sahayak Works
pipeline.subtitle: 8-Step AI Decision Support Pipeline
pipeline.step1Desc: User inputs formulation details, process innovations, or biological sources.
pipeline.step2Desc: spaCy NLP & Gemini extract herbs, botanical names, processes, and locations.
pipeline.step3Desc: Dynamically asks targeted follow-up questions for missing critical fields.
pipeline.step4Desc: Constructs standardized structured JSON fingerprint object.
pipeline.step5Desc: Evaluates applicability across Patent, TKDL, ABS, and Regulatory regimes.
pipeline.step6Desc: Retrieves statutory provisions, Section 3(p), BDA 2023, and Rule 158-B rules.
pipeline.step7Desc: Cross-checks retrieved legal sources for statutory grounding and citations.
pipeline.step8Desc: Generates actionable guidance: What We Detected → Why It Matters → What to Check Next.
knowledge.title: Multi-Regime Intelligence Coverage
knowledge.subtitle: Grounded in Indian statutes, gazette notifications, and official legal databases
knowledge.patentDesc: Explore novelty pathways under Section 3(p) TK exclusions and Section 3(e) synergistic efficacy tests.
knowledge.tkDesc: Identify traditional knowledge overlap with TKDL prior art records and codified classical Ayurvedic texts.
knowledge.absDesc: Determine NBA Form 8 registration and SBB intimation requirements under the Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act 2023.
knowledge.regulatoryDesc: Assign exact regulatory track: Proprietary ASU Drug (Rule 158-B), Classical ASU Drug (Form 25D), or FSSAI Food.
